config.Description: The configuration for the behavior of the site. This configuration exists in the 'firebase.json' file.

redirects.Description:
An array of objects (called redirect rules), where each rule specifies a URL pattern that, if matched to the request URL path,
triggers Hosting to respond with a redirect to the specified destination path.

glob.Description: The user-supplied glob to match against the request URL path.

location.Description:
The value to put in the HTTP location header of the response.
The location can contain capture group values from the pattern using a : prefix to identify
the segment and an optional * to capture the rest of the URL. For example:

'''hcl
redirects {
  glob = "/:capture*"
  status_code = 302
  location = "https://example.com/foo/:capture"
}
'''

regex.Description: The user-supplied RE2 regular expression to match against the request URL path.

status_code.Description: The status HTTP code to return in the response. It must be a valid 3xx status code.

rewrites.Description:
An array of objects (called rewrite rules), where each rule specifies a URL pattern that, if matched to the
request URL path, triggers Hosting to respond as if the service were given the specified destination URL.

function.Description: The function to proxy requests to. Must match the exported function name exactly.

glob.Description: The user-supplied glob to match against the request URL path.

regex.Description: The user-supplied RE2 regular expression to match against the request URL path.

run.Description: The request will be forwarded to Cloud Run.

region.Description: Optional. User-provided region where the Cloud Run service is hosted. Defaults to 'us-central1' if not supplied.

service_id.Description: User-defined ID of the Cloud Run service.

name.Description:
The fully-qualified resource name for the version, in the format:
sites/SITE_ID/versions/VERSION_ID

site_id.Description: Required. The ID of the site in which to create this Version.

version_id.Description: The ID for the version as in sites/SITE_ID/versions/VERSION_ID
